# Homework

- Create a new project for this homework;
- Download the `.rmd` homework document and move it in the new project folder.

[Download homework1.rmd](assets/class5/homework1.rmd){.btn .btn-primary download="homework1.rmd"}

- Open it and write your name in the `author` field.
- Render the file and follow the instructions.
- Do not modify the code chunck before the `Solutions` section!
